main_text.head: NVNCVPATORIA.
main_text.p: 1. Nomina haec ἀρετή & Me-reri, apud Patres, bonis operibus tribui sæpe jactitant: nec hoc dis-simulamus; sed in lata illa signi-ficatione, quam etiam ab Eth-nicis mutuati sunt, pro τυγχάνειν[?], Latinè, Acquirere, consequi, obti-nere, nusquam verò in vero & præciso (quanquam pestifero) sensu Exigendi vitam æternam ex æqualitate justitiæ apud Deum. Facessat igitur omnis verborum [illegible, ~8 letters] nec enim ab externo co-lore, sed ab exitiali malitia inter-na venenum discernitur.
2. Jamdudum Pontificios Pro-testantium autorum fastidium cepit, altúsque despectus; quia nimirum isti (Jesuitæ præsertim)

page.notes: The Greek word after "ἀρετή" and the Greek word in the first line marked [?] are blurred and uncertain. The Greek word at the start of the sixth line of paragraph 1 is illegible. No page number or running head is printed. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
